messages:
dave_sales: Hey team — ACME POC starts Monday. Need a hosted API key scoped to inference only, short TTL (30d) and per-key quota. @maya_se can you confirm recommended rate limit for POC?

maya_se: Recommend 60 RPM and 1M tokens/month cap for initial POC. Tag key with customer=acme & env=poc. Keep scopes to \"inference:hosted\" only.

kevin_cloudops: I can create via Console or CLI. Prefer CLI so we can script rotation. Example CLI: `redwood-cli keys create --name acme-poc-2026 --scopes inference:hosted --expiry 30d --tags customer=acme,env=poc`

kevin_cloudops: Or curl if needed: `curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/keys -H \"Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN\" -H \"Content-Type: application/json\" -d '{"name":"acme-poc-2026","scopes":["inference:hosted"],"expires_at":"2026-04-19T00:00:00Z","metadata":{"customer":"acme","env":"poc"}}'`

rachel_security: Security OK with scoped key + 30d expiry but require tenant-lock (key can only be used against the ACME tenant) and no embedding-write permission. Also want rotation every 14 days for external POC keys.

maya_se: Rotation flow we use: create replacement key, update customer CI/ENV, then revoke old key. Can automate with CLI: `redwood-cli keys rotate --old <old_key_id> --new-name acme-poc-rot-1 --ttl 14d` — it returns the new token.

kevin_cloudops: I'll enable per-key quotas in Console (Billing → API Keys → Quotas) and add an alert webhook on usage >80% so SEs know before we hit limits.

dave_sales: Who will share the secret with ACME SRE? Don't want it in plain Slack.

maya_se: Use 1Password shared vault (acme-poc) or our secure customer secrets flow: 1) create key, 2) store in 1Password entry, 3) send 1Password invite to ACME SRE. Document the key id and tags in the POC tracker.

rachel_security: Also add a line in the security questionnaire: \"Hosted API key is short-lived, tenant-locked, rotated every 14 days, and revoked at POC end.\"

redwood-bot: Reminder scheduled: auto-revoke keys with tag customer=acme on 2026-04-20 09:00 UTC.

dave_sales: Great — please ping here when created so I can share access with the customer. Thanks!
